sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a0 ON a0.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a1 ON a1.person_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.person_id, count(*)::float8 AS v FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id) a2 ON a2.person_id = p.id WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 BETWEEN $3::float8 AND $4::float8) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 = $3::float8) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 > $5::float8) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 >= $3::float8) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 = ANY($6::float8[])) AND COALESCE((COALESCE(a0.v, 0::float8) < $7::float8), false) AND COALESCE((COALESCE(a1.v, 0::float8) <= $8::float8), false) AND COALESCE((COALESCE(a2.v, 0::float8) <> $9::float8), false) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING count(*)::float8 <> ALL($10::float8[]))))
